text: Gleaming Crescent Necklace

<The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before.

Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.

Oh my! I can't believe you found this. I thought I had looked everywhere!

I had lost it when I went to deliver supplies to one of our outposts, but after searching along the road I had given up.

Thank you for bringing this back to me. It was a gift from my late parents, and I can't express how much it means to have it back.
Vengeful Trail

At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.

Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.

Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.
What have you found within the hills of our forest?

Oh no... words like these do not bring me comfort. Kurothel must be more than living in the wild, he's living more like a wild beast each passing night.

I fear the whispers must be true.
Shared Fury

Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.

His written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.

Slay the Xavian, <name>.

Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.
Demons disgrace our ancient culture. They compel our defensive instincts to bare themselves at their most primal. Will we lose ourselves in the strife?

There was a welling up of... Elune's light within and around me. I feel Kurothel has witnessed your act of battle within this war that rages within our land, and within our hearts. 

My hopes are that with time, the efforts of our Sentinels and our wayward druids will eliminate the demonic menace once and for all. Perhaps then and only then will the feral drive for vengeance burn out from our lineage's heritage.

Thank you, <name>. You are a child of the forest, and a valuable spearhead of Kaldorei will.
Forsaken Diseases

The Forsaken, the undead arm of the Horde, have crept into Ashenvale, lurking at our ruins and our barrows.  We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves.  We must confirm this!

The Forsaken have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles.  Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease.  Return with such a bottle.  I will test it and find its purpose.
Bring a Bottle of Disease to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
Did you find the camp, <name>?  Do you have a bottle of disease?
Very good, <name>.  Now... by testing the contents of this bottle, the goals of the Forsaken will be revealed!
Insane Druids

When I struggled with the Forsaken's poisons, I had a vision.  I had a vision of the druids in the Dor'danil Barrow Den, poisoned... murdered by the undead!  They are now errant ghosts, severed from their bodies and driven mad.

So that the druids' spirits might some day find peace, you must enter the Dor'danil Barrow Den and destroy its once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.

Do this, then return to me.
Kill the druids: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak; then return to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.
The anguish of the Dor'danil druids still haunt my dreams, <name>.  You must destroy their leaders!
